meta.title: DeepSeek Usage
meta.description: A DeepSeek usage and budget panel for DSH: official mode reads the host's signed-in account balance, bills, daily usage, and spend; local mode reads DSH session logs from every provider and estimates tokens, costs, and API calls with editable per-model rates. Includes usage calendars, trends, model and session rankings, and official-versus-local reconciliation. Switch themes and customize sidebar Token, spend, and API metrics by toggling, renaming, changing icons, and dragging to reorder. Daily Token/CNY limits circuit-break all subsequent model calls when reached, show a red warning in the status bar, and return a failure reason in the affected conversation; limits reset at Beijing midnight. The header and sidebar share one today-usage snapshot for consistent data. Official billing reuses the DeepSeek Platform account already signed in to DSH and aggregates account-wide usage, including calls from other clients or machines. There is no separate API-key configuration for querying bills. DSH requests made through API keys or other providers appear in local statistics when their session logs report usage; local costs are rate-based estimates and do not equal the provider's actual bill.
